faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about VexShield
faq.supportPrompt: Cannot find what you are looking for? Our support team is here to help.

faqs.question: What is VexShield?
faqs.answer: VexShield is a comprehensive anti-cheat solution designed for FiveM servers with real-time monitoring, intelligent detections, and a web dashboard.

faqs.question: How do I install VexShield?
faqs.answer: Buy a license, download the resource from your dashboard, upload it to resources, add ensure airshield to server.cfg, configure your IP and license key, then restart.

faqs.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
faqs.answer: Basic FiveM knowledge helps, but the dashboard is designed to be simple. Documentation and Discord support are available.

faqs.question: How does VexShield detect cheaters?
faqs.answer: It uses behavior analysis, signature checks, injection detection, resource monitoring, and network analysis.

faqs.question: Can I customize protections?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can enable protections, choose actions, configure blacklists, sensitivity, and webhook notifications.

faqs.question: Does VexShield support Discord?
faqs.answer: Yes. It supports Discord login, alerts, blacklist checks, and AirEye bot workflows.

faqs.question: What products does VexShield offer?
faqs.answer: VexShield covers the whole protection suite: VexShield anti-cheat, AirScanner resource/backdoor scanning, PCChecker/AirPC PC verification, the AirEye Discord bot, the web dashboard, and the user search tools powered by tokens.

faqs.question: How do search tokens work?
faqs.answer: Each user search costs 1 token. Daily tokens refill automatically every day at 12:00 (noon) UTC based on your plan (Free 2, 1 Month 10, 3 Months 20, Lifetime 30) and do not roll over. You can also buy tokens at $1 = 30 tokens; purchased tokens never expire. If a search returns no result, no token is spent. The same balance is shared across the website search, the AirEye bot's Check User command, and the Search API.

faqs.question: Is there a Search API for developers?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can create a personal API key on the Tokens & Plans page and run searches from your own project (Node, Python, PHP, anything) via GET /api/v1/search. Each successful search spends 1 token from your balance (no-result searches are free). Keep your key secret  anyone with it can spend your tokens. Full code examples are in the Search API documentation.

faqs.question: What are wallet funds?
faqs.answer: Wallet funds are a prepaid account balance you can use to pay for products, renewals, and tokens inside VexShield. Funds are non-refundable and non-withdrawable.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answer: No. All sales are final. We do not offer refunds, exchanges, returns, partial refunds, or store credit for any product, plan, renewal, add-on, search tokens, or wallet funds.

faqs.question: Will I be reported to the police?
faqs.answer: No. VexShield does not file reports, complaints, or police/criminal reports against its customers or users, now or in the future. We will not report you, your server, or your account to the police or any authority for using our products.

faqs.question: What support is available?
faqs.answer: Support is available through Discord, documentation, and staff assistance.

faqs.question: Can I extend my license?
faqs.answer: Yes. Renewals are manual and add full time to your license.
